title: Tuffness
description: Changes the Tuff related blocks to something... tuff?
body:
Makes the Tuff block (and all related blocks) into something _"tuff"_. I would never see why anyone would use this, but it's a thing now I guess. Somebody probably asked for this?

This is my first resource pack and modrinth page I've ever made, I do **_NOT_** know what I am doing, so please be kind if it looks a little bland! :)

CREDITS:
Made with Itsme64's Texture Pack Maker (https://www.convertmcpack.net/maker.php)
